title: feat(spec)!: an object-master-detail-form block's detail entries are a strict shape whose columns are the inline grid column contract (#20928)
body:
Fixes #20928

Clause-②: yes

The third carrier of the inline grid column is brought to the contract the other two already hold. `ComponentPropsMap['object-master-detail-form'].details` was `z.array(z.unknown())`; each entry is now a strict shape of the keys objectui's `MasterDetailForm` reads, and its `columns` references `InlineGridColumnSchema`. `defineStack`'s identity-only check (`collectHydratedInlineColumnErrors`) now reaches the block on a page, and `field-no-consumers` reads a detail entry as a child collection. Governed by ruling `5791803339` (#19629, letter B) and ruling `5805782503` (#19910, letter 乙); routed by triage `5919655566`.

## What changed

- **`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`**: `details` is `z.array(masterDetailDetailEntry())`. The entry is a `strictObject` with `childObject` (required), `relationshipField`, `columns` (`z.array(InlineGridColumnSchema)`, the same object, not a copy), `formFields`, `inlineMode` (`grid` or `form`), `amountField`, `sortField`, `totalField`, `title`, `minRows`, `maxRows`, `addLabel`. The keys shared with a form view's `subforms[]` entry take that entry's types and alias table. The entry is built inside the props schema's own lazy body, as the `subforms[]` entry is: a standalone `lazySchema` element is a function-typed proxy the alias-integrity graph walk never descends into (measured: `alias-integrity.test.ts` went red on it, see commit `e734f15e`). New type `ObjectMasterDetailFormPropsParsed`: the props schema's input and output now differ, because the column schema's are different.
- **`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`**: the page-component traversal that `collectInlinePageActions` owned (regions, slots, nested container arrays) is extracted into `forEachPageComponent`, unchanged, and the collector walks it for `object-master-detail-form` blocks, judging `details[j].columns` against `details[j].childObject`. A column is judged only once it parses as a column WITHOUT the resolved type. On the two parsed carriers this was already true. On the page carrier, whose `properties` the stack parse never reaches, it keeps every finding one that the resolved type brings; a column with its own defects is left to the component-props gate.
- **`packages/lint/src/validate-field-consumers.ts`**: `CHILD_COLLECTION_KEYS` gains `details`. A detail entry's column `name`, `amountField` and `relationshipField` credit the child's field, `totalField` the parent's, and an entry without `columns` credits the derived grid. The page slot map's own `details` key holds components, which carry none of an entry's keys at their own level. A pinned control shows such a component is read the same under `slots.details` as under `slots.header`.
- **ADR-0087**: new D3 semantic entry `ui-object-master-detail-form-details-closed`, plus a step-18 rationale fragment (order 56). `gen:migration-registry` regenerated the registry. No D2 conversion, per the census below.
- **`content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`**: the master-detail example's `columns: [product, quantity, unit_price]` (bare strings) becomes three `name:` columns. The strict entry refuses bare strings, and the renderer could not draw them either: `hydrateColumns` returns a string column unchanged, and the grid reads `col.name`.
- Generated: `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` (one new site, `ui/ObjectMasterDetailFormProps` at `details.element.columns.element`, plus its two counts), `api-surface/ui.json`, `export-origins/ui.json`, `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`, `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/ui.md`. `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` drops the props schema's isomorphism pin (779 to 778) for the new `XParsed` alias, the route that file prescribes.
- Changeset `.changeset/20928-master-detail-details-closed.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor (BREAKING, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, marker `registered ui-object-master-detail-form-details-closed`), `@objectstack/lint` patch.

## Measurements

**Premise** (`origin/main` `2c1cef3345` at dispatch, re-read at this head): `details: z.array(z.unknown()).optional()` sat at `component.zod.ts:4776`. Premise holds.

**The read set**, from objectui `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx` at the `.objectui-sha` pin `31971ff1e28f`. The file is byte-identical at the dispatch pin `e420df310f5b`. `MasterDetailDetailConfig` is declared at `:64-93`. Each of its twelve keys has a live read: `childObject` `:986`, `:1003`; `relationshipField` `:1033`, `:1312`; `columns` `:858`, `:928`, `:1034`; `formFields` `:847`, `:1063`; `inlineMode` `:850`, `:1064`; `amountField` `:861`, `:1035`, `:1550`; `sortField` `:862`, `:1038`; `totalField` `:1549`; `title` `:755`; `minRows` `:863`; `maxRows` `:864`; `addLabel` `:865`. A grep of every `d.X`, `detail.X` and `e.config.X` member read in the file finds no thirteenth key; `detail.saving` and `detail.add` are i18n keys. `deriveDetail` hydrates an authored list with `hydrateColumns` and derives with `deriveColumns`, the same rule `deriveInlineGridColumns` reproduces.

**Census** (`origin/main` `ebdb6f2aca`, the branch point): blocks typed `object-master-detail-form` appear in the showcase `project-workspace.page.ts` (one entry, `{ title, childObject, addLabel }`, no columns), in one doc example (three bare-string columns, rewritten here), and in the lint and spec test fixtures (copies of the showcase entry). `sdui.manifest.json` is objectui's registry, not a producer. `field`-keyed detail columns: 0. The regex `details:.*field:` does match three API-error `details` payloads elsewhere, so the matcher is live. Control: one authored `inlineColumns` block in `examples/` (showcase `invoice.object.ts`). So only a narrowing marker is owed. Page-component `properties` is not parsed on the save or load path, so no stored row is ever refused, and no conversion is registered.

**Collector reach**: `config.pages` is reachable from the collector, and the existing page walk already reached component `properties` with hard cross-reference errors (inline actions). Measured below.

**Field-consumer scan**: before this change it did not read `details[].columns[].name` (`CHILD_COLLECTION_KEYS` was `subforms` only). Ablation A4 below confirms it.

**Pinned objectui** (`31971ff1e28f`, `git grep`): the only non-test importer is `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:52` / `:3913`, which takes `ObjectMasterDetailFormPropsSchema` by reference through `stripImportedDefaults`, a generic walk. The tests `registered-type-arms-10859-b2.test.ts` compare the node's props to `SpecObjectMasterDetailFormProps` by reference on both sides, and their showcase fixture `{ title, childObject, addLabel }` stays valid. No value the narrowed type refuses was found at that pin. objectui's own suites against this spec: NOT MEASURED (objectui coordination, below).

**Public door** (`os validate --json`, CLI built at `bfb26d52`, a probe stack with a currency child field):

| probe column(s) | exit | `valid` | finding |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `{ name: 'amount', type: 'currency', scale: 2 }` | 0 | true | advisory `component-props-invalid` at `properties.details.0.columns.1.scale`, the ruled first sentence |
| `{ zzz_not_a_key: 1 }` | 0 | true | advisory `component-props-unknown-key` (`zzz_not_a_key`) and `component-props-invalid` (`name` required) |
| `{ name: 'amount', scale: 2 }` over a `currency` field | 1 | false | `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID`: `Page 'probe_invoice_entry' (regions.0.components.0) object-master-detail-form details[0].columns[1].scale: column 'amount' declares no type, so it renders as a currency column …` |
| `{ name: 'quantity' }, { name: 'amount' }` (control) | 0 | true | none; and `field-no-consumers` reports neither child field |

## Verification (at `bfb26d52`, after merging `origin/main` `0d421041` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`)

- `@objectstack/spec` `vitest run --project local`, two shards: 297 + 297 files passed, 8915 + 8511 tests passed, 1 todo. `--project repo` subset (`step18-rationale-merge`, `conversions-major18-merge`, `retired-key-migrate-sentence`): 35 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes both edited test files, and none of the errors held in the debt ledger names them.
- `@objectstack/lint` `vitest run`: 118 files / 5494 passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- Consumers, each named package exactly (`--filter PKG`, not a closure): `@objectstack/sdui-parser` 13 files / 217 passed; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 200 passed, 3 skipped files / 2973 passed, 19 skipped. Packages whose fixtures write the block: spec and lint only, covered above.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 15 artifacts up to date after a fresh build.
- Derived gates `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`: 114 derived, 114 run, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". Three first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples`) and were green after `turbo run build` over `./packages/*` and `./packages/*/*`. Five roster gates marked as sharing a directory with this diff (`check-changeset-fixed`, `check:meta-url-spelling`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`) and `check-sdui-manifest`: exit 0.
- ESLint, a narrowed run, stated as such. `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 8 changed `.ts` files reports files 8, errors 0, warnings 0. The population is `eslint.config.mjs:971`, `**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}`. That config never enables type-aware linting (its comment at `:326-328`: no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from committed state (`bfb26d52`), each restored with blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. A first pass at `074d6ca4`, before the entry became a factory, gave the same four counts. The subjects resolve to `src` through relative imports, so no dist leg was owed.
  - A1 `details: z.array(masterDetailDetailEntry())` → `z.array(z.unknown())` (blob `72d6abd987ce` → `242fee1c1fb5`): carriers pin `8 failed | 28 passed (36)`. All seven props-half refusals went red, plus the first assertion of the "left to the props half" pin. I predicted 7; the eighth is that pin's own props-half check.
  - A2 the collector's page loop emptied (`aa6368d1f138` → `318e3e0ee35f`): `2 failed | 34 passed`. Those are the region refusal and the nested and slot refusal.
  - A3 the valid-without-type precondition deleted (`aa6368d1f138` → `047cac280736`): `1 failed | 35 passed`. The red run printed the misattribution the precondition exists to stop: "column 'amount' declares no type, so it renders as a currency column … Unrecognized key(s) on this inline grid column: zzz_not_a_key".
  - A4 `CHILD_COLLECTION_KEYS` back to `subforms` only (`3efd1236571e` → `7b8b0ab03798`): `3 failed | 66 passed (69)`. Those are the authored column, `amountField`, and the derived grid.
  - A5 the doc's old bare-string columns restored (`b6df7f7748e0` → `2aef1e440273`): `check:yaml-examples` exit 1, "1 of 19 tagged YAML block(s) do not hold their claim … expected object, received string" at `layout-dsl.mdx:774`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Two enforcement tiers on one carrier.** The entry and column half is read where every page component's props are read: the component-props gate, advisory by its own declared posture (`validate-component-props.ts` header). So the card's typed and bogus columns move from silent green to `valid: true` with advisory findings. The identity-only column is a hard cross-reference error, like the inline-action targets already judged on the same pages. Upgrading the props gate is that gate's own step.
- **Save door**: a page saved through the metadata door keeps a failing detail entry, because `properties` is not parsed there. This is the same posture as every page-component narrowing in step 18. NOT MEASURED at the door.
- **Scan, adjacent position**: `field-no-consumers` still reads a detail entry's `sortField` and `formFields` in the parent's context, through the general walk. Not changed here. #21091's positions are not touched.
- **Files beyond the claim's list**: `layout-dsl.mdx` (a producer the census found, which `check:yaml-examples` reds on, see A5), `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` and `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` (both forced by referencing the column schema). `conversions/registry.ts` and the showcase page are untouched, because nothing needed converting or rewriting.
- The D3 entry `inline-grid-column-identity-only-currency-scale-refused` still names its two carriers. The new entry records the third rather than editing a step-18 text that other open PRs hold.
- `origin/main` moved after the merge (`e18fea6d`). Its only spec file is `data/filter.zod.ts`, which this diff does not touch. Merge-queue revalidation covers it.
- objectui's `MasterDetailForm` mirror and its spec-parity probes over this row are not in this PR. The seat files the objectui coordination child.
